logic.bm: Per FY2025 annual report (p.11-13): six product groups — 智能变配电系统 (relay protection, substation monitoring/automation, smart-substation systems, distribution terminals & DA systems), 直流输电系统 (±1100kV UHVDC and ±800kV VSC-HVDC converter valves, DC measurement, DC control & protection), 智能电表 (smart meters, terminals, AMI, MCBs), 智能中压供用电设备 (switchgear, transformers, reactors, arc-suppression-coil grounding sets, ring-main units), 新能源及系统集成 (PV/storage EPC & integration, grid-forming PCS, hydrogen power supplies), 充换电设备及其它制造服务 (EV chargers incl. liquid-cooled ultra-fast, battery swap, EMS contract manufacturing). FY2024 revenue split: 智能变配电 4,711m (27.6%), 智能电表 3,866m, 智能中压供用电 3,352m (19.6%), 新能源及系统集成 2,464m, 直流输电 1,444m, 充换电及其它 1,252m. Transformer exposure is small: subsidiary 许继变压器有限公司 (78%) revenue 1,134.95m in FY2025 (1,212.81m FY2024) per AR note.
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

structural_breaks.note: FY2018 annual report restates FY2017 营业收入 10,330.72 → 10,329.49 (−1.23m, retrospective presentation adjustment; immaterial). FY2017 quarterly points keep the as-published 2017 AR quarterly table.

同一控制下企业合并 during H1 2020: FY2019 restated 10,156.08 → 10,852.45 (+696.36m, +6.9%); H1 2019 3,054.49 → 3,317.46; 9M 2019 5,238.22 → 5,658.88. The FY2020 AR quarterly table restates FY2020Q1 to 1,023.33 (Q1 report as published: 917.40, comparative 1,032.57 old scope) — so FY2020Q1/Q2/Q4 YoY vs FY2019 points mixes scopes (no like-for-like 3-month comparative printed; Q1 comparative therefore omitted). FY2020Q3 carries the same-scope comparative 2,341.42 from the Q3 report.

同一控制下企业合并 + 会计政策变更 recognised in FY2023 AR: FY2022 restated 14,917.45 → 15,029.74 (+112.29m, +0.75%); FY2023 quarterly table restated in-year (Q1 3,263.67 → 3,308.77; H1 7,114.26 → 7,203.04; 9M 10,663.89 → 10,829.98). FY2023 quarters therefore have no same-scope printed comparative; YoY vs FY2022 points is biased up by ≈1%. FY2024 reports print restated FY2023 comparatives equal to the FY2023 quarterly table.
